name: techdella/form
title: Form (Startbuddi)
description: A lead form that posts to WordPress and is forwarded to the matching Startbuddi endpoint. Pill options, inline validation, success state; works without JavaScript.

techdella.help: Pick the form (one per Startbuddi endpoint). Leave title, intro, button label and success message empty to use the defaults. Hidden values: e.g. {"resource_slug":"ai-search-readiness-checklist"} for a resource download, {"tool_slug":"utm-builder"} for a tool.
